thread:
alyssa (support): Heads up — Ruxton Labs has put our invoice on hold. Procurement says they will not accept any invoice unless we include an explicit 'order auth id' (numeric only) and their cost center. They also want the signed SOW attached. Can finance produce a proforma we can send to procurement? cc @matt-sales

matt-sales: I talked to their buyer yesterday. They insisted on a 6-digit numeric OA value in the invoice metadata (no OA- prefix). They want invoices sent to procurement@ruxton.com and the billing contact to read 'Ruxton Labs, Attn: Accounts Payable'.

jen-finance: We can do a proforma. Need exact OA field format and confirmation if they require the PO number on the PDF filename or inside the invoice body. Example options: 247918 OR 247918-PO. Which do they want? Also they requested a W-9 attached, correct?

alyssa (support): Customer clarified: numeric only, example OA 247918. They want net30 payment terms and W-9 on file. They also said they won't process our final invoice until they issue their internal PO (procurement policy).

sophie-cust-success: I have the signed SOW (signed by both parties). Uploading to internal drive: SOW-Ruxton-signed.pdf. @jen-finance can you attach that to the proforma? They asked whether we can issue a provisional invoice number while waiting for the PO.

jen-finance: We can issue a proforma labeled 'Pending PO' and include a provisional invoice reference (example: INV-RED-20220345). Final invoice conversion will happen when the PO arrives. Quick legal check needed if SOW content can be visible on the invoice. @legal any concerns?

legal: Quick review — SOW sig is fine. No additional redlines needed. Recommend we avoid publishing negotiated discount lines on the public proforma; use standard line item descriptions. Otherwise good to proceed.

alyssa (support): I replied to procurement to offer proforma with provisional invoice number and requested the official OA numeric value and their PO upload URL. Customer replied: 'Please send proforma to procurement@ruxton.com and reference OA 247918. We will not accept a vendor invoice without a formal PO. If PO not issued within 7 days we will ask for a budget estimate for approval.'

matt-sales: :thumbsup: I'll follow up with their procurement contact to push for the PO. ETA: try to get the contact and PO by EOD tomorrow.

billing-bot: Proforma generated: PROFORMA-RED-20220345 created by jen-finance. Files attached: proforma.pdf, w9.pdf, signed-sow.pdf

alyssa (support): Marking this in the support tracker as 'on hold - awaiting customer PO'. Tagging @sophie-cust-success and @matt-sales for updates. If we don't receive PO in 7 days escalate to the account exec.

jen-finance: Noted. Proforma ready to convert when PO arrives. Internal ref logged: RUO-247918. Closing loop from finance side for now.
